summary.headline: Interrogation About a Dead Man’s Possessions
summary.text: Astrological instructions explain timing a matter by degree-by-degree conjunctions involving Mercury, the Sun, the lord of the ascendant, and the Moon, illustrated by a promised object left for its owner. Chapter VII introduces an interrogation about the abandoned possessions of a dead person, giving the ascendant, midheaven, planetary positions, and Venus’s separation from Jupiter, lord of the house of substance.
